name: Wolfight: Duel for the Win
storyline:
During his countless journeys across dimensions, the legendary Maxiumus Arefin discovered a place unlike any other: a mysterious dimension made up of numerous planets, each inhabited by creatures, monsters, and adventurers seeking glory.

In this dimension, the battle never ends. Every day, thousands of heroes set out on new adventures, facing increasingly powerful enemies, collecting legendary equipment, and putting their skills to the ultimate test. But what makes this place truly unique is the endless competition among adventurers. Every quest, every victory, and every monster defeated adds to their reputation, allowing heroes to climb the Dimensional Leaderboards and earn their place among the greatest warriors of all time.

Fascinated by his discovery, Maxiumus Arefin gave this dimension a name destined to become legendary: Wolfight. Since then, new adventurers have continued to journey to its planets, driven by the desire to push beyond their limits and prove their worth.
summary:
Take on powerful opponents and fearsome monsters with your Hero and their equipment. Fight your way to the top of the leaderboards, prove your strength, and become a legend!
May the D20 be with you!
